warden_holt.name: Warden Holt

dialogue.hail: Hail, {name}. Keep your wits about you out here. The [gnolls] have grown bold this season.
dialogue.gnolls: Mangy curs from the camp east of my post. They raid the road and bite anyone who strays from the stones. The watch pays a bounty on [gnoll fangs].
dialogue.gnoll fangs: Bring me four gnoll fangs, pulled from pups or scouts, it matters not. Hand them to me when you have them and I'll pay you from the watch's purse. And if you go near their camp, beware [Grubnak].
dialogue.grubnak: Grubnak the Mangy, their chief. Twice the size of his kin and meaner than a cornered badger. He shows his face at the camp now and then. Don't go alone.

warden_holt.outfitter: Empty-handed, {name}? The wilds took your kit, I'd wager. Here, from the Watch's stores. Try to keep hold of it this time.

dialogue.hail: Move along, {name}. The [Watch] keeps the peace here. If trouble follows you down this road, run to us.
dialogue.watch: We patrol the walls and the road to Greenmoor. Warden Holt keeps a watch house in the far north of Greenmoor, where he can keep an eye on the gnoll camp. If you've a mind for honest work, he pays a bounty on [gnoll fangs].
dialogue.gnoll fangs: Not to me. Take them to Warden Holt. His watch house is past the obelisk, up in the far north of Greenmoor.
dialogue.unknown: I'm on duty, {name}. Ask the Keeper at the hearth if you want stories.

shouts: Stand fast, {name}! The Watch is here!
Not on my road, you mangy cur!
shouts_player: Halt, {name}! In the name of the Watch!

dialogue.hail: Hail, {name}. I walk this road from the Emberhold gate to the [obelisk] and back, sunup to sundown. Slow, aye, but I get there.
dialogue.obelisk: The old stone where the road ends. Past it is gnoll country. Anything with teeth that wanders onto my road gets a sword for its trouble. If you've earned the [Watch]'s trust, I'll come for you when you're in trouble.
dialogue.watch: Friends of the Watch get help on my road. Strangers get a good view. Thin out the gnolls and Warden Holt will see your name goes around.
dialogue.unknown: I'm walking, {name}, not talking. Keep up or step aside.

shouts: Friend of the Watch in trouble!
hunt_shouts: Back to the wilds with you!
shouts_player: Halt, {name}! In the name of the Watch!

dialogue.hail: Welcome to Emberhold, {name}. Warm your hands at the [hearth]. It has burned since the [Emberfall], and it will burn long after us.
dialogue.hearth: No wood feeds it and no rain drowns it. The Keepers tend it all the same. Those who fall in these lands wake beside a [bindstone], drawn back to warmth.
dialogue.emberfall: The night the sky burned, a star came down into this hollow and would not cool. The first settlers raised walls around its heat. That ember is the one before you.
dialogue.bindstone: The hearth here, and the old obelisk in Greenmoor. When you fall, you wake at the bindstone of the land you fell in. Your belongings, sadly, stay where you dropped.
dialogue.unknown: Many things are forgotten, {name}, but not that one. I don't know it.

dialogue.hail: Welcome, welcome, {name}! Leathers for the road, and I'll take whatever you drag back from it. Fangs, eyes, [whiskers], it's all coin to me.
dialogue.whiskers: Rat whiskers! Brush-makers in the lower city can't get enough. Don't ask me why.
dialogue.unknown: I only know prices, {name}. Ask the Keeper for the rest.

dialogue.hail: Hmph. Iron's good, steel's better, and I've only got iron this season. The [gnolls] keep hitting the ore carts.
dialogue.gnolls: Take your complaint to Warden Holt, not me. Or take a sword to them. I'll sell you one.

dialogue.hail: The Hearthbank of Emberhold, at your service, {name}. What you leave with me stays safe when you [fall].
dialogue.fall: Fall in the wilds and what you carry stays on your corpse. What's in my vault stays in my vault. Choose wisely what you carry.
dialogue.unknown: I'm afraid I only keep accounts, {name}.

dialogue.hail: Shh! Easy, {name}, you'll spook the [trout]. Name's Merrick. I sell poles and bait to anyone with the patience to use them.
dialogue.trout: Greenmoor trout, fat as your fist. Most of them, anyway. There's one in this pond a good deal bigger. [Old Gulper], I call him.
dialogue.old gulper: Thirty years I've been after that fish. He's snapped more of my lines than I can count. One of these days, {name}. One of these days.
dialogue.unknown: Hm? Sorry, I was watching my line.

guildmaster.refuse: I train warriors, {name}. Soft hands like yours want Sister Anwen or the Magister.

dialogue.hail: You there, {name}! Think you can hold a line? The Watch trains every [warrior] who can, and a few who can't.
dialogue.warrior: Steel, sweat and stubbornness. Come to me as you grow and I'll teach you to bandage yourself, to bash, and to roar. Press G to train.

guildmaster.refuse: The hearth calls whom it calls, {name}. You're not one of mine. Try Sergeant Brask or Magister Coyle.

dialogue.hail: Peace of the hearth to you, {name}. Those who [tend] it learn to mend what the wilds tear.
dialogue.tend: Clerics of the hearth heal, shield and, when we must, smite. As you grow, I'll teach you more. Press G to train.
dialogue.unknown: The Keeper knows more lore than I, {name}.

guildmaster.refuse: Hmm? Oh, no, no. I teach wizards. You want the Sergeant, or the Sister at the hearth.

dialogue.hail: Ah, {name}. Careful, the ink's still wet. You've an interest in the [arcane]?
dialogue.arcane: Frost, fire, and the binding of limbs. I teach wizards who have survived long enough to be worth teaching. Press G to train.
